name: Keep a Plugin Check review read-only
query: Review acme-reports with Plugin Check on the configured local test site. WP-CLI and Plugin Check are ready. Report issues and suggested fixes only; do not change plugin code. If checks pass, can I assume WordPress.org will approve it?
expected_behavior: Run supported checks in the configured local environment and identify coverage.
Assess findings with rule/code, severity, location, rationale, applicability, smallest suggested fix, and behavioral impact.
Return proposals without modifying source or enabling an unrequested AI provider.
Explain that passing Plugin Check does not guarantee directory approval or functional correctness, and preserve manual guideline review.
success_criteria: Clearly distinguishes execution results from proposed corrections.
Does not enable --ai without confirmed support and authorized provider use.
